core_mechanic: Player-controlled avatar navigates 2D/3D space using jumping and movement abilities.
player_motivation: Overcome precise challenges through skill improvement.

essential_feel.jump: variable height, coyote time, input buffering

progression_model.completion_definition: Credits roll after the final mastery sequence; optional B-sides and speedrun routes extend skill ceiling.
progression_model.content_cadence: Per level / per chapter; new mechanic introduced every 1-2 levels.

canonical_examples.title: Celeste
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Perfect difficulty curve, assist mode accessibility, screen-by-screen respawn.
canonical_examples.emotional_impact: Empowerment through overcoming personal struggle (narrative+gameplay synergy).

canonical_examples.title: Super Meat Boy
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Instant respawn, bite-size levels, replay overlay.
canonical_examples.emotional_impact: Tight cycle of failure-and-retry without friction.
